# mHUB Resources

> Central hub for mHUB members to access facilities, memberships, educational programs, and account management for Chicago's 63,000 sq ft hardtech innovation center.

mHUB is a hardtech innovation center in Chicago supporting entrepreneurs and companies through membership tiers, collaborative spaces, mentorship programs, and industry partnerships. The resources site serves as the primary member portal for account access, facility booking, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- mHUB
- Enterprise Membership
- Member Access
- Authentication
- Account Recovery

- Chicago Innovation
- Hardtech

## Membership & Facilities

- [Enterprise Membership Level](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/page/enterprise): Enterprise membership tier with access to mHUB facilities and community
- [Large Conference Room - All Day (Member Price)](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/product/view/Large_Conference_Room_-_All_Day_(Member_Price)): mHUB conference room rental with member pricing
- [Shop Now at mHUB](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/product/view/Sku_Hold_14): mHUB product shop with membership plans and facility services
- [mHUB Virtual Tour](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/page/mhub-virtual-tour): Virtual tour of mHUB's 63,000 sq ft hardtech innovation center

## Member Account & Authentication

- [Login to your account - mHUB](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/page/technology-roadmap): Member login portal for account and event access
- [Retrieve My Password - mHUB](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/password_forgot.aspx): Password reset and account recovery for mHUB members

## Educational Programs & Community

- [mHUB Curriculum](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/page/mhub-curriculum): Educational curriculum and learning resources for mHUB members
- [mHUB Group Mentorship](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/page/mhub-group-mentorship): Structured mentorship programs connecting members with industry experts

- [Terms and Conditions](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/terms): Master Services Agreement and terms of use for mHUB services
- [Privacy Policy / Cookies Policy](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/privacy): mHUB privacy and data collection practices policy
- [Cookies Policy](https://resources.mhubchicago.com/cookie): Cookie usage and browser control preferences for mHUB
